# LLM translation matrix

What busbar translates between LLM dialects. A request or answer that stays in its own dialect
passes through whole; one that crosses dialects carries every concept both dialects map and
drops the rest with a warning. Each cell is the dialect's wire path for the concept (notation A:
`a.b` member, `a[]` items, `<tag>=<arm>` union arm); `code` names the dialect code that carries
it; `-` means the dialect has no form for it.

| openai_chat | request | 32 | 2 |
| openai_responses | request | 22 | 1 |
